SunDog>--Frozen Legacy is an action and
adventure game set in a future age of
interstellar merchant trade.  You play the
role of a young glass miner who inherits a
small starship . . . and the debts of its
former owner.  These debts obligate you to
colonists to a new colony on Jondd.
Once there, you can buy and sell cargo or supplies,
or mingle with traders in a local pub, but watch
for hoodlums out to steal your hard-earned credits!
The SunDog can roam through a region of twelve star systems.
